title: THC Simple User Terms
source: Derived only from words used in Batch 1 v2 learner copy.

terms.definition: The stage when a seed opens and the first root appears.
The first white root that comes out of a seed.
A young baby plant with its first leaves and roots.
The stage when the plant builds roots, stems, leaves, and branches.
The stage when buds begin to form.
A plant type that flowers when the dark period is long enough.
A plant type that flowers by age, not by a 12/12 light cycle.
Gentle moving air that helps reduce stale, wet pockets around plants.
Tiny resin glands on buds and leaves that help show maturity.
The final storage step after drying, when moisture evens out in the flower.
Bugs, mites, mildew, rot, or damage that should be caught early.
How much moisture is in the air compared with how much the air can hold.
